{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "SUTI.studium study session",
  "description": "A minimal, privacy-aware plan for one learning session. This schema does not authorize data collection, transfer, or deployment.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "version",
    "status",
    "subject",
    "setting",
    "learning_goal",
    "starting_task",
    "source",
    "practice_step",
    "feedback_criterion",
    "transfer_task",
    "access_options",
    "minimum_data_needed",
    "data_not_needed",
    "permissions_review",
    "safeguarding_review",
    "responsible_role",
    "learner_can_pause",
    "alternative_path",
    "record",
    "external_transfer",
    "evidence_status",
    "decision"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$",
      "maxLength": 96
    },
    "version": { "const": 1 },
    "status": { "enum": ["example-template", "draft", "reviewed", "archive"] },
    "subject": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "setting": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learning_goal": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "starting_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "source": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["title", "url", "checked_on", "rights_status"],
      "properties": {
        "title": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "url": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
        "checked_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "anyOf": [
            { "const": "" },
            { "format": "date" }
          ]
        },
        "rights_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "practice_step": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "feedback_criterion": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "transfer_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "access_options": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "minimum_data_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "data_not_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 30,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "permissions_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "safeguarding_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "support_review": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional, non-personal preflight. Store roles and routes, never participant names, diagnoses, or sensitive disclosures.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "participant_can_choose_format",
        "concern_contact_role",
        "alternate_concern_route",
        "confidentiality_limits_explained",
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed",
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed",
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "participant_can_choose_format": { "type": "boolean" },
        "concern_contact_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "alternate_concern_route": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "confidentiality_limits_explained": { "type": "boolean" },
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE"] },
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "responsible_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learner_can_pause": { "type": "boolean" },
    "alternative_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "record": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "enabled",
        "owner_role",
        "access_roles",
        "retention_or_deletion_rule",
        "correction_path",
        "export_path",
        "deletion_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": { "type": "boolean" },
        "owner_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "access_roles": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
          "maxItems": 20,
          "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "retention_or_deletion_rule": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "correction_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "export_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "deletion_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 }
      }
    },
    "external_transfer": { "const": "HOLD" },
    "evidence_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "decision": { "enum": ["COMMIT", "HOLD", "ROLLBACK"] }
  }
}

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "SUTI.studium study session",
  "description": "A minimal, privacy-aware plan for one learning session. This schema does not authorize data collection, transfer, or deployment.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "version",
    "status",
    "subject",
    "setting",
    "learning_goal",
    "starting_task",
    "source",
    "practice_step",
    "feedback_criterion",
    "transfer_task",
    "access_options",
    "minimum_data_needed",
    "data_not_needed",
    "permissions_review",
    "safeguarding_review",
    "responsible_role",
    "learner_can_pause",
    "alternative_path",
    "record",
    "external_transfer",
    "evidence_status",
    "decision"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$",
      "maxLength": 96
    },
    "version": { "const": 1 },
    "status": { "enum": ["example-template", "draft", "reviewed", "archive"] },
    "subject": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "setting": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learning_goal": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "starting_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "source": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["title", "url", "checked_on", "rights_status"],
      "properties": {
        "title": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "url": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
        "checked_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "anyOf": [
            { "const": "" },
            { "format": "date" }
          ]
        },
        "rights_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "practice_step": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "feedback_criterion": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "transfer_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "access_options": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "minimum_data_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "data_not_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 30,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "permissions_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "safeguarding_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "support_review": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional, non-personal preflight. Store roles and routes, never participant names, diagnoses, or sensitive disclosures.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "participant_can_choose_format",
        "concern_contact_role",
        "alternate_concern_route",
        "confidentiality_limits_explained",
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed",
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed",
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "participant_can_choose_format": { "type": "boolean" },
        "concern_contact_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "alternate_concern_route": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "confidentiality_limits_explained": { "type": "boolean" },
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE"] },
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "responsible_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learner_can_pause": { "type": "boolean" },
    "alternative_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "record": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "enabled",
        "owner_role",
        "access_roles",
        "retention_or_deletion_rule",
        "correction_path",
        "export_path",
        "deletion_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": { "type": "boolean" },
        "owner_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "access_roles": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
          "maxItems": 20,
          "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "retention_or_deletion_rule": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "correction_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "export_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "deletion_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 }
      }
    },
    "external_transfer": { "const": "HOLD" },
    "evidence_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "decision": { "enum": ["COMMIT", "HOLD", "ROLLBACK"] }
  }
}

P1-002:schema.content_utf8:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "SUTI.studium study session",
  "description": "A minimal, privacy-aware plan for one learning session. This schema does not authorize data collection, transfer, or deployment.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "version",
    "status",
    "subject",
    "setting",
    "learning_goal",
    "starting_task",
    "source",
    "practice_step",
    "feedback_criterion",
    "transfer_task",
    "access_options",
    "minimum_data_needed",
    "data_not_needed",
    "permissions_review",
    "safeguarding_review",
    "responsible_role",
    "learner_can_pause",
    "alternative_path",
    "record",
    "external_transfer",
    "evidence_status",
    "decision"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$",
      "maxLength": 96
    },
    "version": { "const": 1 },
    "status": { "enum": ["example-template", "draft", "reviewed", "archive"] },
    "subject": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "setting": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learning_goal": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "starting_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "source": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["title", "url", "checked_on", "rights_status"],
      "properties": {
        "title": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "url": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
        "checked_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "anyOf": [
            { "const": "" },
            { "format": "date" }
          ]
        },
        "rights_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "practice_step": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "feedback_criterion": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "transfer_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "access_options": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "minimum_data_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "data_not_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 30,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "permissions_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "safeguarding_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "support_review": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional, non-personal preflight. Store roles and routes, never participant names, diagnoses, or sensitive disclosures.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "participant_can_choose_format",
        "concern_contact_role",
        "alternate_concern_route",
        "confidentiality_limits_explained",
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed",
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed",
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "participant_can_choose_format": { "type": "boolean" },
        "concern_contact_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "alternate_concern_route": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "confidentiality_limits_explained": { "type": "boolean" },
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE"] },
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "responsible_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learner_can_pause": { "type": "boolean" },
    "alternative_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "record": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "enabled",
        "owner_role",
        "access_roles",
        "retention_or_deletion_rule",
        "correction_path",
        "export_path",
        "deletion_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": { "type": "boolean" },
        "owner_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "access_roles": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
          "maxItems": 20,
          "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "retention_or_deletion_rule": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "correction_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "export_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "deletion_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 }
      }
    },
    "external_transfer": { "const": "HOLD" },
    "evidence_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "decision": { "enum": ["COMMIT", "HOLD", "ROLLBACK"] }
  }
}

P1-002:schema.content_utf8:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "SUTI.studium study session",
  "description": "A minimal, privacy-aware plan for one learning session. This schema does not authorize data collection, transfer, or deployment.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "version",
    "status",
    "subject",
    "setting",
    "learning_goal",
    "starting_task",
    "source",
    "practice_step",
    "feedback_criterion",
    "transfer_task",
    "access_options",
    "minimum_data_needed",
    "data_not_needed",
    "permissions_review",
    "safeguarding_review",
    "responsible_role",
    "learner_can_pause",
    "alternative_path",
    "record",
    "external_transfer",
    "evidence_status",
    "decision"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$",
      "maxLength": 96
    },
    "version": { "const": 1 },
    "status": { "enum": ["example-template", "draft", "reviewed", "archive"] },
    "subject": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "setting": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learning_goal": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "starting_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "source": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["title", "url", "checked_on", "rights_status"],
      "properties": {
        "title": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "url": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
        "checked_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "anyOf": [
            { "const": "" },
            { "format": "date" }
          ]
        },
        "rights_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "practice_step": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "feedback_criterion": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "transfer_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "access_options": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "minimum_data_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "data_not_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 30,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "permissions_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "safeguarding_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "support_review": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional, non-personal preflight. Store roles and routes, never participant names, diagnoses, or sensitive disclosures.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "participant_can_choose_format",
        "concern_contact_role",
        "alternate_concern_route",
        "confidentiality_limits_explained",
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed",
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed",
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "participant_can_choose_format": { "type": "boolean" },
        "concern_contact_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "alternate_concern_route": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "confidentiality_limits_explained": { "type": "boolean" },
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE"] },
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "responsible_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learner_can_pause": { "type": "boolean" },
    "alternative_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "record": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "enabled",
        "owner_role",
        "access_roles",
        "retention_or_deletion_rule",
        "correction_path",
        "export_path",
        "deletion_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": { "type": "boolean" },
        "owner_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "access_roles": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
          "maxItems": 20,
          "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "retention_or_deletion_rule": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "correction_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "export_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "deletion_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 }
      }
    },
    "external_transfer": { "const": "HOLD" },
    "evidence_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "decision": { "enum": ["COMMIT", "HOLD", "ROLLBACK"] }
  }
}

P1-002:schema.content_utf8:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "SUTI.studium study session",
  "description": "A minimal, privacy-aware plan for one learning session. This schema does not authorize data collection, transfer, or deployment.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "version",
    "status",
    "subject",
    "setting",
    "learning_goal",
    "starting_task",
    "source",
    "practice_step",
    "feedback_criterion",
    "transfer_task",
    "access_options",
    "minimum_data_needed",
    "data_not_needed",
    "permissions_review",
    "safeguarding_review",
    "responsible_role",
    "learner_can_pause",
    "alternative_path",
    "record",
    "external_transfer",
    "evidence_status",
    "decision"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$",
      "maxLength": 96
    },
    "version": { "const": 1 },
    "status": { "enum": ["example-template", "draft", "reviewed", "archive"] },
    "subject": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "setting": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learning_goal": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "starting_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "source": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["title", "url", "checked_on", "rights_status"],
      "properties": {
        "title": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "url": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
        "checked_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "anyOf": [
            { "const": "" },
            { "format": "date" }
          ]
        },
        "rights_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "practice_step": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "feedback_criterion": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "transfer_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "access_options": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "minimum_data_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "data_not_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 30,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "permissions_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "safeguarding_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "support_review": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional, non-personal preflight. Store roles and routes, never participant names, diagnoses, or sensitive disclosures.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "participant_can_choose_format",
        "concern_contact_role",
        "alternate_concern_route",
        "confidentiality_limits_explained",
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed",
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed",
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "participant_can_choose_format": { "type": "boolean" },
        "concern_contact_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "alternate_concern_route": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "confidentiality_limits_explained": { "type": "boolean" },
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE"] },
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "responsible_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learner_can_pause": { "type": "boolean" },
    "alternative_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "record": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "enabled",
        "owner_role",
        "access_roles",
        "retention_or_deletion_rule",
        "correction_path",
        "export_path",
        "deletion_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": { "type": "boolean" },
        "owner_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "access_roles": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
          "maxItems": 20,
          "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "retention_or_deletion_rule": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "correction_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "export_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "deletion_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 }
      }
    },
    "external_transfer": { "const": "HOLD" },
    "evidence_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "decision": { "enum": ["COMMIT", "HOLD", "ROLLBACK"] }
  }
}

P1-002:schema.content_utf8:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "SUTI.studium study session",
  "description": "A minimal, privacy-aware plan for one learning session. This schema does not authorize data collection, transfer, or deployment.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "version",
    "status",
    "subject",
    "setting",
    "learning_goal",
    "starting_task",
    "source",
    "practice_step",
    "feedback_criterion",
    "transfer_task",
    "access_options",
    "minimum_data_needed",
    "data_not_needed",
    "permissions_review",
    "safeguarding_review",
    "responsible_role",
    "learner_can_pause",
    "alternative_path",
    "record",
    "external_transfer",
    "evidence_status",
    "decision"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$",
      "maxLength": 96
    },
    "version": { "const": 1 },
    "status": { "enum": ["example-template", "draft", "reviewed", "archive"] },
    "subject": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "setting": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learning_goal": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "starting_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "source": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["title", "url", "checked_on", "rights_status"],
      "properties": {
        "title": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "url": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
        "checked_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "anyOf": [
            { "const": "" },
            { "format": "date" }
          ]
        },
        "rights_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "practice_step": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "feedback_criterion": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "transfer_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "access_options": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "minimum_data_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "data_not_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 30,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "permissions_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "safeguarding_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "support_review": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional, non-personal preflight. Store roles and routes, never participant names, diagnoses, or sensitive disclosures.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "participant_can_choose_format",
        "concern_contact_role",
        "alternate_concern_route",
        "confidentiality_limits_explained",
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed",
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed",
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "participant_can_choose_format": { "type": "boolean" },
        "concern_contact_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "alternate_concern_route": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "confidentiality_limits_explained": { "type": "boolean" },
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN", "NOT_APPLICABLE"] },
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "responsible_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learner_can_pause": { "type": "boolean" },
    "alternative_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "record": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "enabled",
        "owner_role",
        "access_roles",
        "retention_or_deletion_rule",
        "correction_path",
        "export_path",
        "deletion_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": { "type": "boolean" },
        "owner_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "access_roles": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
          "maxItems": 20,
          "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "retention_or_deletion_rule": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "correction_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "export_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "deletion_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 }
      }
    },
    "external_transfer": { "const": "HOLD" },
    "evidence_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "decision": { "enum": ["COMMIT", "HOLD", "ROLLBACK"] }
  }
}

{

  "required": [

    "version",
    "status",
    "subject",
    "setting",

    "starting_task",
    "source",

    "feedback_criterion",
    "transfer_task",
    "access_options",
    "minimum_data_needed",
    "data_not_needed",

    "safeguarding_review",
    "responsible_role",
    "learner_can_pause",
    "alternative_path",
    "record",
    "external_transfer",
    "evidence_status",
    "decision"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$",
      "maxLength": 96
    },
    "version": { "const": 1 },
    "status": { "enum": ["example-template", "draft", "reviewed", "archive"] },

      "properties": {
        "title": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },
        "url": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
        "checked_on": {
          "type": "string",
          "anyOf": [
            { "const": "" },
            { "format": "date" }
          ]
        },
        "rights_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "practice_step": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "feedback_criterion": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "transfer_task": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 2000 },
    "access_options": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true

    "minimum_data_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "data_not_needed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
      "maxItems": 30,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "permissions_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "safeguarding_review": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "support_review": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional, non-personal preflight. Store roles and routes, never participant names, diagnoses, or sensitive disclosures.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "participant_can_choose_format",
        "concern_contact_role",
        "alternate_concern_route",
        "confidentiality_limits_explained",
        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed",
        "local_emergency_route_reviewed",
        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "participant_can_choose_format": { "type": "boolean" },
        "concern_contact_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "alternate_concern_route": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500 },

        "identity_disclosure_risk_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },

        "disclosure_protocol_reviewed": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] }
      }
    },
    "responsible_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
    "learner_can_pause": { "type": "boolean" },
    "alternative_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
    "record": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "enabled",
        "owner_role",
        "access_roles",
        "retention_or_deletion_rule",
        "correction_path",
        "export_path",
        "deletion_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "enabled": { "type": "boolean" },
        "owner_role": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
        "access_roles": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 240 },
          "maxItems": 20,
          "uniqueItems": true
        },
        "retention_or_deletion_rule": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "correction_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "export_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 },
        "deletion_path": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 1000 }
      }
    },
    "external_transfer": { "const": "HOLD" },
    "evidence_status": { "enum": ["PASS", "PARTIAL", "FAIL", "UNKNOWN"] },
    "decision": { "enum": ["COMMIT", "HOLD", "ROLLBACK"] }
  }
}
